query:
INSERT INTO assessment.submissions
                         (id, assignment_id, student_id, status, attempt, content, submitted_at,
                          auto_scores)
                     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, CASE WHEN $4 = 'submitted' THEN 1 END, '{}',
                             CASE WHEN $4 = 'submitted' THEN now() END, $5)
